address: San Gregorio 17, Aranda de Duero, 09400, Spain
bio: If you’re visiting Aranda de Duero and its impressive network of underground wine cellars featuring over 4km of galleries, this centrally located restaurant could be a good option to revive your energy levels. Featuring a tapas section by the entrance and a dining room to the rear (the latter featuring a view of the wood-fired oven), Aitana has a reputation for its red meats and seasonal vegetables, although the menu also includes mouthwatering IGP Castilla y León baby lamb (prior ordering required). The à la carte is complemented by the Ribera set menu....
